# scm_dlp_data_profile (Resource)

DLP Data Profile resource (`/v2/api/data-profiles`). Manages detection rules with boolean expression trees or multi-profile compositions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scm_dlp_data_pattern_list" "credit_card" {
  name = "Credit Card Numbers"
}

resource "scm_dlp_data_pattern" "employee_id" {
  name = "Custom-Employee-ID"
  type = "custom"

  detection_config = {
    technique                   = "weighted_regex"
    supported_confidence_levels = ["high"]
  }

  matching_rules = {
    regexes = [{ regex = "EMP-[0-9]{6}", weight = 10 }]
  }
}

# Triggers on 5+ unique credit card numbers, or on any employee ID.
resource "scm_dlp_data_profile" "pci_and_employee_pii" {
  name        = "PCI-and-Employee-PII"
  description = "5+ unique credit card numbers, or any employee ID"

  detection_rules = [
    {
      rule_type = "expression_tree"
      expression_tree = {
        operator_type = "or"
        sub_expressions = [
          {
            rule_item = {
              id                       = data.scm_dlp_data_pattern_list.credit_card.data[0].id
              name                     = "Credit Card Numbers"
              detection_technique      = "regex"
              occurrence_operator_type = "more_than_equal_to"
              occurrence_count         = 5
              confidence_level         = "high"
              by_unique_count          = true
            }
          },
          {
            rule_item = {
              id                       = scm_dlp_data_pattern.employee_id.id
              detection_technique      = "weighted_regex"
              occurrence_operator_type = "any"
            }
          },
        ]
      }
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `detection_rules` (Attributes List) List of detection rules. Must be all `expression_tree` or all `multi_profile`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detection_rules))
- `name` (String) The name of the data profile (up to 64 characters).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the data profile.
- `is_granular_data_profile` (Boolean) Whether this is a granular data profile composing multiple child data profiles.
- `profile_status` (String) Profile status: `active` or `inactive`. Defaults to `active`.
- `profile_type` (String) Profile type: `advanced` or `basic`. Defaults to `advanced`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the data profile.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `version` (Number) The version number of the profile. Incremented by the backend on every update.

<a id="nestedatt--detection_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detection_rules`

Required:

- `rule_type` (String) Rule type: `expression_tree` or `multi_profile`.

Optional:

- `expression_tree` (Attributes) Expression tree defining boolean logic and leaf rule items. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detection_rules--expression_tree))
- `multi_profile` (Attributes) Multi-profile composition rule (combines multiple data profile IDs). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detection_rules--multi_profile))

<a id="nestedatt--detection_rules--expression_tree"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detection_rules.expression_tree`

Optional:

- `expression_tree_json` (String) Optional raw JSON escape hatch for arbitrarily deep expression trees.
- `operator_type` (String) Logical operator: `and`, `or`, `not`, `and_not`, `or_not`.
- `rule_item` (Attributes) Leaf detection rule item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detection_rules--expression_tree--rule_item))
- `sub_expressions` (Attributes List) Sub-expressions (level 1) under this logical operator. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detection_rules--expression_tree--sub_expressions))

<a id="nestedatt--detection_rules--expression_tree--rule_item"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detection_rules.expression_tree.rule_item`

Required:

- `detection_technique` (String) The detection technique used (e.g. `regex`, `weighted_regex`, `ml`, `edm`, `dictionary`, `document_fingerprint`, `trainable_classifier`, `ml_document`, `file_property`, `pab`).
- `id` (String) The ID of the detection primitive (data pattern, dictionary, document type, ML model, etc.).
- `occurrence_operator_type` (String) Occurrence operator: `any`, `less_than_equal_to`, `more_than_equal_to`, `between`.

Optional:

- `by_unique_count` (Boolean) Whether to evaluate occurrences by unique matches. Defaults to `false`.
- `confidence_level` (String) Confidence level: `low`, `medium`, `high`. Defaults to `high`.
- `match_type` (String) Match type: `include` or `exclude`. Defaults to `include`.
- `name` (String) Descriptive name of the rule item.
- `occurrence_count` (Number) Match count threshold when operator is `more_than_equal_to` or `less_than_equal_to`.
- `occurrence_high` (Number) Upper occurrence bound when operator is `between`.
- `occurrence_low` (Number) Lower occurrence bound when operator is `between`.


<a id="nestedatt--detection_rules--expression_tree--sub_expressions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detection_rules.expression_tree.sub_expressions`

Optional:

- `operator_type` (String) Logical operator: `and`, `or`, `not`, `and_not`, `or_not`.
- `rule_item` (Attributes) Leaf detection rule item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detection_rules--expression_tree--sub_expressions--rule_item))
- `sub_expressions` (Attributes List) Nested sub-expressions (level 2) enabling native HCL boolean structures like OR-of-ANDs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detection_rules--expression_tree--sub_expressions--sub_expressions))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing DLP data profile by its ID.
terraform import scm_dlp_data_profile.example <id>
```
